title: Feature request - sms commands
body: Is there a way to remotely force collector restart in xdrip? Something like sms commands in aaps? Or better even have follower or nightscout issue restart collector command?

comments.body: You could use a Plugin for remote control of Tasker on the phone to start a command to restart collector with the xDrip+ plugin.
@Kaivish Did you try the suggestion of @doc77?
